title: Automated Brand Reporting Workflow
headline: A reporting workflow that keeps moving.
summary: A recurring reporting process that connects source systems, output files and brand-specific recipient settings.
tools: Python, SQL Server, Excel, Google Sheets
coverNote: Project description based on Sofwan’s resume. The workflow diagram is an illustration of the process, not a live system.

blocks.html:
The question

How can a recurring reporting process become more repeatable while still producing the different files and recipient groups each brand needs?

The approach

Retrieve data from K2 and ITOS, transform it in Python, and generate detail and summary Excel reports. Keep brand-specific recipient configuration in Google Sheets.

What it enables

A structured workflow for producing student and personal reporting outputs, with recipient configuration managed separately from the transformation process.
